description: Upload raw audio bytes content-addressed by CID, returning an AT Protocol blob ref to embed on a post.

main.description: Accepts raw audio bytes in the request body (max 25 MB; `Content-Type`: m4a, mp4, mpeg, webm, ogg, wav), matching `com.atproto.repo.uploadBlob`. Optional query parameters `spaceType` + `skey` (and `spaceAuthority`), or `remoteSpace` (`at:space/{authority}/{type}/{skey}`), store the blob privately in that space. Supports `Idempotency-Key`.

blob.description: Canonical AT Protocol blob ref for the stored audio — pass verbatim as the post embed's `audio`.

space.description: The space the blob is stored in, when private. Absent means public. The first upload of identical bytes decides visibility.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: Empty body, unsupported audio Content-Type, invalid space parameters, or a `remoteSpace` hosted by this tenant.

errors.name: RecordNotFound
errors.description: The named hosted space does not exist for this tenant.

errors.name: PayloadTooLarge
errors.description: Audio payload exceeds the 25 MB limit.

errors.name: Conflict
errors.description: An earlier request with the same Idempotency-Key is still in flight.
